question: Six people, G, H, I, Q, R and S, are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only three people sit between Q and I. G sits to the immediate left of I. No one sits to the right of S. Only one person sits between S and G. R sits to the immediate right of H. How many people sit between I and R?
solution:
**Given:**

Six people G, H, I, Q, R and S are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only three people sit between Q and I.

G sits to the immediate left of I.

No one sits to the right of S.

Only one person sits between S and G.

R sits to the immediate right of H.
